name: compile-gauntlet
title_zh: 把模糊想法编译成可执行的技能包
tagline_zh: 面对一段视频、一篇论文、一个截图或一句「做个类似的」，它能产出完整 Gauntlet Pack。不用再猜需求。
tagline_en: Turn a video, paper, screenshot, or 'make something like this' into a complete Gauntlet Pack. Stop guessing.
desc_en: Convert vague goals, reference repositories, YouTube demonstrations, blogs, social discussions, screenshots, live products, papers, target data sources, or adaptation requests into complete agent-executable Gauntlet Packs. Use before implementation when requirements are underspecified, public evidence must be reconstructed into an independent production-grade product, a repository must be pivoted
why_zh: 不是简单总结，而是把散落证据重构为独立可产出的规格：拆解、补全、编排成 agent 能直接跑的步骤链。
why_en: Not a summarizer—it reconstructs scattered evidence into standalone, production-ready specs: decomposed, completed, and.
limit_zh: 只产出 Gauntlet Pack 规格文档，不写实现代码；需要目标域有可参照的公开证据（视频/仓库/论文）。
limit_en: Outputs spec docs only, no code. Needs public evidence (video/repo/paper) to work from; pure verbal descriptions stall it. Stops at executable.
